description: This PHP source file defines a REST API controller class 'LicenseFileAPI' within the OrangeHRM installation system. The class handles GET requests to retrieve the contents of the project's LICENSE file.

classes.name: LicenseFileAPI
classes.description: A REST controller class extending AbstractInstallerRestController that provides an endpoint to retrieve the content of the LICENSE file.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests by returning the content of the LICENSE file as a JSON response.
